items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex gains 200 pts, Nifty around 25,200; SMIDs underperform
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Monday:In the broader market, the Nifty MidCap 100 and the Nifty SmallCap 100 fell 0.41 per cent and 0.78 per cent, respectively

items.title: Patanjali Foods dips 4% as Q2 profit slips but analysts upbeat; here's why
items.description: Jefferies said that Patanjali Foods' Q2 miss was driven by a shift in festive-season timing and edible-oil margin pressure from the import duty cut.

items.title: Hospital stocks in focus: Max Healthcare, Aster DM, Fortis surge up to 7%
items.description: Share price of Max Healthcare soared 7% to ₹1,007.70 on the BSE in Monday's intraday trade, bouncing back 26% from its 52-week low of ₹797 touched on October 22, 2026.

items.title: Mahindra Logistics shares plunge 14% after MD and CEO Hemant Sikka resigns
items.description: The company has appointed Mohammed Turra as Additional Director and MD & CEO-designate, effective November 16.

items.title: NSE stock market-cap crosses ₹5 trillion; scrip up 16% from IPO price
items.description: With a ₹5.11 trillion market-cap on Monday, NSE stood at the 10th position in the overall market cap ranking among BSE listed companies, surpassing LIC, data shows.

items.title: 23 companies to see IPO lock-in expiry by Nov-end; Jio Platforms in focus
items.description: The market performance of the 30-day group has been positive so far, with all 11 stocks trading above their respective IPO issue prices.

items.title: Pricol sinks 20% after Street's thumbs down to auto electronics arm sale
items.description: Pricol promoters will sell their entire 38.51 per cent stake in the automotive electronics business to global private equity firm Warburg Pincus after it is demerged into a separate entity.

items.title: Skyways Air zooms 9% as Q2 PAT jumps 130% YoY, but remains below IPO price
items.description: Since listing, Skyways Air Services' stock has failed to reclaim the IPO price, as its all-time high is ₹137.25. The all-time low stands at ₹91.80 apiece.

items.title: Tata Motors PV shares plunge 9% after Q2 results; brokerages cut target
items.description: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles (TMPV) reported a consolidated net loss of ₹5,451 crore from continuing operations for the second quarter of financial year 2026-27

items.title: Airtel, Voda Idea rally up to 3%; here's why telecom stocks are in demand
items.description: Among other telecom stocks, Bharti Hexacom, Tata Communications and Indus Towers also gained in the range of 2-3% on the BSE in Monday's trading session.

items.title: India to benefit from unwinding of AI trade, says CEA Anantha Nageswaran
items.description: India has largely been sidelined during the AI investment boom of the past two years, and its stock market has performed accordingly

items.title: Angel One flags breakout on Acutaas, Indus Towers and one more stock
items.description: Hitesh Rathi, Technical Analyst-Equity & Derivatives at Angel One flags technical breakout on Acutaas Chemicals, Indus Towers and GE Vernova T&D India stock charts.

items.title: VA Tech Wabag cracks 10% as Saudi cancels ₹2,332 cr desalination tender
items.description: VA Tech Wabag received intimation from the Saudi Water Authority regarding cancellation of the tender for its 300 MLD mega sea water desalination plant at Yanbu, Saudi Arabia, worth ₹2,332 crore.

items.title: India deserves re-rating; Sensex may hit 95,000 by Dec 2027: Morgan Stanley
items.description: As an investment strategy, Morgan Stanley favours Domestic Cyclicals over Defensives and externally facing sectors; and are overweight Financials, Consumer Discretionary, and Industrials.

items.title: Kaynes Technology shares tank 18% as Q2 PAT plunges 65%, margin shrinks
items.description: Kaynes Technology has reported a consolidated net profit of ₹39.8 crore in Q2FY27, down 65 per cent from ₹115.7 crore posted in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

items.title: Eicher Motors shares gain 3.5% on record Q2 show; margin recovery key
items.description: Eicher Motors posted its highest-ever quarterly revenue and operating income in Q2 FY27 amid strong demand momentum and recovery in exports.

items.title: Asian shares fall before Nvidia earnings, Anthropic IPO test tech rally
items.description: In Asia on Monday, Japan's Nikkei fell 0.6%, while South Korea slipped 0.2%. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan eased 0.1%

items.title: Will inflation, Iran tension spook the market bulls? Jefferies, HSBC answer
items.description: In its latest assessment, Christopher Wood identified a fresh escalation in tensions involving Iran as the biggest risk to Indian equities, both in terms of absolute returns and relative performance.
